program.name: Yin and Breath
program.subject: Yin yoga
program.blurb: A few gentle movements, then long yin holds and a quiet close.
program.about: Yin with a softer start. A short opening of cat-cow and easy hip and spine movements warms you, then five yin shapes held for minutes each, then a long rest. Two practices alternate between hips and spine. Both later levels hold every pose longer.
program.split: Yin holds & a gentle opening A / B
